key.name: assistant-enabled
key.summary: Enable the Lemonade AI assistant in the overlay search

key.name: assistant-idle-unload
key.summary: Minutes before an idle local model is unloaded
key.description: The local chat model takes several gigabytes of memory while it is loaded. After this many minutes without a request it is unloaded; the next question loads it again, which takes a few seconds. 0 keeps it loaded.

key.name: lemonade-model
key.summary: Model the embedded Lemonade server uses for the assistant
key.description: The embedded server listens on 127.0.0.1:13345 by default (not Lemonade's usual 13305). Override the port by writing UMOJA_LEMONADE_PORT=PORT to ~/.config/umoja/lemonade.env.

key.name: assistant-backend
key.summary: Where the assistant's chat model runs
key.description: 'local' uses the embedded Lemonade server and lemonade-model. 'cloud' sends assistant requests to the OpenAI-compatible endpoint in cloud-base-url using cloud-model. The API key is kept in the keyring, never in GSettings. File search embeddings always stay local.

key.name: cloud-base-url
key.summary: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible cloud endpoint

key.name: cloud-model
key.summary: Model name requested from the cloud endpoint

key.name: file-search-enabled
key.summary: Index the home folder so files can be found by what they're about
key.description: umoja-files keeps a local index in ~/.cache/umoja/files. Hidden folders, .gitignore'd paths and folders holding .nomedia, .trackerignore or CACHEDIR.TAG are left out. Content is embedded only on mains power, by the embedded Lemonade server.

key.name: file-search-embedding-model
key.summary: Lemonade embedding model used for file search
key.description: Downloaded through the embedded Lemonade server on an unmetered connection. Changing it re-embeds the index.

key.name: dictation-hotkey
key.summary: Extra shortcut to toggle Myna voice dictation
key.description: Myna Settings binds Myna's own shortcut (Super+J by default) as a GNOME custom shortcut, which Umoja honours; this key is only an additional one.

key.name: ask-umoja-alt-tap
key.summary: Tap Alt to open Ask Umoja on keyboards without a Copilot key
key.description: The Copilot key always opens Ask Umoja. Until one has been pressed on this computer, a lone tap of the left Alt key opens it too, as Unity's HUD did. Once a Copilot key has been seen (ask-umoja-copilot-seen), Alt is left to the apps.

key.name: ask-umoja-copilot-seen
key.summary: A Copilot key has been pressed on this computer
key.description: Set by the compositor on the first Copilot key press. While true, tapping Alt no longer opens Ask Umoja. Reset it to use Alt again.

key.name: ask-about-screen-hotkey
key.summary: Ask the assistant about the selected text or the current window

key.name: copy-text-hotkey
key.summary: Copy the text in a screen area
key.description: Opens the screenshot UI in Copy Text mode: drag out an area and its text is read with Tesseract OCR and put on the clipboard.

key.name: screensaver-enabled
key.summary: Show the screensaver before the screen blanks
key.description: When the session has been idle for Settings › Power › Screen Blank (org.gnome.desktop.session idle-delay), show the Umoja screensaver instead of turning the screen off straight away. The screen blanks screensaver-duration seconds later. Off: blank at idle-delay, as GNOME does.

key.name: screensaver-duration
key.summary: How long the screensaver runs before the screen blanks
key.description: Seconds. 0 keeps the screensaver running until you come back.

key.name: auto-do-not-disturb
key.summary: Hold back notifications while recording or in full screen
key.description: Don't show notification banners while the screen is being recorded or a fullscreen window (a game, a video, a presentation) has the focus. They still go to the message list, critical ones still show, and afterwards one banner says how many arrived.

key.name: screenshot-names
key.summary: Name screenshots after what they show
key.description: After a screenshot is saved from the screenshot UI, read its text and let the local model add a few words to its file name ("Screenshot From 2026-11-12 10-04-33 – Invoice from Acme.png"). Runs on this computer only; the name stays as it was if there is no text or no model.

key.name: crash-notifications
key.summary: Tell me when an app crashes
key.description: Show a notification when a program crashes (from Apport's reports in /var/crash, or systemd-coredump), with a button to ask the assistant why. The diagnosis runs on the local model.

key.name: crash-notifications-muted
key.summary: Programs whose crashes don't show a notification
key.description: Program names (for example 'nautilus'), as added by the notification's "Don't Show for This App" button.

key.name: ai-agent
key.summary: Coding agent the assistant hands coding jobs to
key.description: One of 'claude' (Claude Code), 'codex', 'gemini' (Gemini CLI) or 'opencode', used when it is installed. Empty picks the first one installed; 'none' turns the hand-off off. Umoja never installs one.

key.name: ai-agent-hotkey
key.summary: Open the coding agent in a terminal

key.name: clipboard-history-hotkey
key.summary: Show the clipboard history

key.name: shortcuts-guide-hotkey
key.summary: Show the keyboard shortcuts guide

key.name: clipboard-history
key.summary: Keep a clipboard history
key.description: Remember text copied this session (in memory only, never on disk) so the overlay can offer it again with translate, reformat and summarize actions. Text that password managers mark as secret is never recorded.

key.name: tile-top-left
key.summary: Tile window to the top-left quarter

key.name: tile-top-right
key.summary: Tile window to the top-right quarter

key.name: tile-bottom-left
key.summary: Tile window to the bottom-left quarter

key.name: tile-bottom-right
key.summary: Tile window to the bottom-right quarter
